settings.webLookupCopy: When a question needs current information, like weather or news, this device searches the web with DuckDuckGo and reads the best page before answering. Only the search words leave this device. Answers list their sources.
settings.memoryCopy: Say “Remember that …” in a chat and it is kept on this device for future chats. Turning memory off keeps what is saved.
settings.resetCopyMemories: Restore the welcome setup. Clears chats and memories on this device and forgets the connected computer.
